description: The Modern tower-one at three stars (the towerone fixture with vipFavorable cleared, vipVisits zeroed and the treasury filled) sells its Security office and both Medical centers so a fire is likelier and nothing fights it, runs at hour ticks until a fire breaks out and the rescue offer is pending, and leaves it unanswered: the next day's roll declines it and the parking space burns down. A second fire is then started by hand in the tower proper and burns and spreads for nine days with nobody to fight it.
